vkt_derivation: FHWA Highway Statistics VM-1 light-duty vehicle-kilometres (short- plus long-wheelbase) divided by the registered light-duty vehicle count of the same year. Parameters are read from the latest observations at or before 2024; the cohorts they price were sold in 2025 and later, and the trajectories are indexed on t = years after sale, not on calendar year.
scenario_exclusion_reason: S2: flag_no_ndc: FLAG market: Guideline FLAG-market case: the United States notified withdrawal from the Paris Agreement on 2025-01-27, effective one year later; no NDC in force for the lifetime of any current cohort under committed policy. S2 excluded from the headline and reported separately; S1/S3 require IEA WEO STEPS/NZE rates. S2 is excluded from the headline and reported separately. Anchor verified: no.
warnings: VKT_TIER_B: FHWA VM-1 partitions light-duty vehicles by wheelbase (short and long), not by body type, so the denominator is all light-duty vehicles rather than passenger cars as defined in the EU27 series; numerator and denominator are consistent with each other but the classification is not the registration-based one, hence tier B. | LIFETIME_TIER_C: the operating life is the NHTSA expected-lifetime figure, computed from a survival schedule fitted to 1977-2002 passenger-car registrations and scrappage, not to the current fleet; low and high are the central value minus and plus 3 years, the same bracket the lifetime sensitivity moves.
